name: The Visions of N'Zoth Campaign
summary: A strategic dossier of N'Zoth's assaults, the defense of mind and world, and the campaign into Ny'alotha.

phases.title: The prison opens
phases.summary: N'Zoth's release turns hidden pressure into open assault.
phases.narration: What had whispered beneath history stepped into its open page, and the wounded world found no shelter in disbelief.

phases.title: Assaults fall upon the world
phases.summary: Forces of the Old God attack key regions while corruption spreads through vision and fear.
phases.narration: The assault was made against walls and wills together; the map's violet shadows mark pressure, not measured borders.

phases.title: The defenders learn to endure the visions
phases.summary: Champions prepare to resist corruption while answering the assaults.
phases.narration: To reach the enemy, the defenders first had to carry an answer within themselves.

phases.title: The campaign enters Ny'alotha
phases.summary: The struggle crosses into N'Zoth's terrible domain.
phases.narration: The atlas cannot place that nightmare as an ordinary province. It names the crossing and refuses a false geography.

phases.title: The immediate assault is ended
phases.summary: N'Zoth is defeated and the campaign closes.
phases.narration: The vision broke and the world remained—scarred, uncertain, and soon to face a wound in the boundary of death itself.

outcome.summary: Champions defeated N'Zoth and ended his immediate assault on Azeroth.

geographicEditorNote: Ny'alotha is not treated as a conventional measured place, and the multi-region campaign has no single exact marker.
